Sample Protein Interaction Network

sample_ecg.Rd

A curated subset of the human STRING network (version 12.0) with interaction scores of 900 or higher. The network has been trimmed to create a smaller, more manageable example for the package's vignettes and tests.

Usage

sample_ecg

Format

An object of class ECGraph with 7244 nodes (elements) and 286,341 edges.

Source

https://string-db.org/ Data from STRING is licensed under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
